question: Is there happy hour at Coco Maya on weekends?
answer: No, happy hour at Coco Maya runs Monday through Friday only, 4:00–6:00 PM, on the rooftop patio in Little Italy. On Saturdays and Sundays, the patio shifts to daily brunch instead, served until 3:00 PM, followed by the regular dinner and cocktail menu the rest of the day.
